l.i: [?]bus paterna gentem nubant. Ita non
transferetur Israelitarum hæreditas de
tribu in tribum, dum quisque in sua pa-
tria tribus hæreditate hærebit. Atque om-
nis filia hæres instituta, ex quacunque
Israelitarum tribuum, alicui tribui suo
nuptum locetur, ut Israelitarum quisque pa-
ternas hæreditates possideant, ne hæredi-
tates ex aliis in alias tribus transeant,
dum Israelitarum quisque in sua tribu
hæreditate hærebit. Numeri 36.
LXVII.
Ne cum eis (gentibus) fœdus initote: né-
ve earum miserti[?] fueritis: néve affinita-
tem cum eis contrahitote, aut filias ve-
stras illorum filiis locando, aut illorum filias
vestris filiis conjungendo. Alioqui fi-
lios vestros à Iova ad peregrinorum deo-
rum cultum abducent: ita fiet, ut iratus
Iova vos brevi perdat. Deuteron.7.
LXVIII.
Si quis deprehensus fuerit concubuis-
se cum fœmina maritum habente, ambo
juxtà moriuntor, tum vir qui fœminam
constuprarit, tum fœmina: idq; nefas ex
Israe-

page.notes: The first word is cut off at the left edge of the scan; read as "bus" with a doubtful initial letter. "miserti" is printed with a letter that looks like j; read as "miserti" and marked doubtful. The mark after "contrahitote" is a printer's tie or ornament, not a letter; it is not transcribed. "non" after "Ita" is partly obscured by a smudge. The headings LXVII and LXVIII are bare numbered canons and are written as paragraphs. The last line ends mid-word ("Israe-") and continues on the next page.
